crossRefs.note: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and…
Joshua the son of Nun secretly sent two men out of Shittim as spies, saying, “Go, view the land, including Jericho.”…
With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.
You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people…
Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds…
So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”
translations.bsb: “Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.”
translations.kjv: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler
translations.asv: Send thou men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a prince among them.
